### renderError

|  |  |
| --: | :-- |
| Type: | `(error: Error) => void` |
| Kind: | async, parallel |
| Previous: | Any hook from [`renderStart`](#renderstart) to [`renderChunk`](#renderchunk) |
| Next: | If it is called, this is the last hook of the output generation phase and may again be followed by [`outputOptions`](#outputoptions) if another output is generated |

Called when Rollup encounters an error during `bundle.generate()` or `bundle.write()`. The error is passed to this hook. To get notified when generation completes successfully, use the `generateBundle` hook.

If a `renderError` hook itself fails, Rollup reports both the original rendering error and the hook failure together. The combined error retains the original error's code and plugin metadata.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
